concerns.text: SC-001 (processed‑prompt completion rate ≥ 95 %) is not linked to any task; no task records or validates this metric, making the success criterion untestable.

The Quickstart guide (quickstart.md) outlines execution steps, but no task in tasks.md is explicitly tied to producing or verifying the Quickstart artifacts (e.g., a ‘run‑pipeline’ verification task).
